subcategory_text: Risk management objectives are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-09, RA-07, SR-02
CRI Profile v2.0: GV.RM-01, GV.RM-01.01, GV.RM-01.02, GV.RM-01.03, GV.RM-01.04, GV.RM-01.05
implementation_examples: Update near-term and long-term cybersecurity risk management objectives as part of annual strategic planning and when major changes occur
Establish measurable objectives for cybersecurity risk management (e.g., manage the quality of user training, ensure adequate risk protection for industrial control systems)
Senior leaders agree about cybersecurity objectives and use them for measuring and managing risk and performance
assessment_objectives: Determine whether risk management objectives are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders.
Determine whether activities are conducted to update near-term and long-term cybersecurity risk management objectives as part of annual strategic planning and when major changes occur.

Determine whether activities are conducted to establish measurable objectives for cybersecurity risk management (e.g., manage the quality of user training, ensure adequate risk protection for industrial control systems).
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
